interpretation_limits: verified_complete means raw artifact integrity for the expected routes, not performance acceptance or a product fix.
Each population was verified separately. Instrumented resources, stage-only, and compiled-out controls are not pooled, and local runs do not constitute independent repeated A/B evidence.
Per-route wall and thread CPU quantiles are descriptive. CPU greater than wall samples and every strict wall deadline miss are preserved, not clamped or recoded.
Wall minus CPU and parent-minus-direct-child wall residuals are not exact operating-system scheduling or virtualization delays.
Worker overlap is descriptive; separate caller-main publications are not joined to the worker CPU stream.
Logical memory bytes are not measured cache misses or hardware bandwidth. Outside-timer touching does not lock pages or guarantee continued residency.
The C++ new/delete guard reports the observed operators only; it is not universal malloc, lock, or system-call tracing.
Linux thread_rusage resource capture does not validate macOS process/task counters or continuous scheduler state.
AU, VST3, CoreAudio device callbacks, real DAW uninterrupted playback, and editor interaction are NOT_EXECUTED.
Any cause-specific performance intervention needs independent repeat evidence and a separate development PR without relaxed response, channel, fade, or realtime gates.
